name: InteractionDetector
src_typeComment: Drop on the player: detects the nearest IInteractable within range and fires events to show/hide a prompt UI and to trigger interaction on key press. Detection uses OverlapSphere, so it works for any collider layout without needing trigger volumes hand-placed on every interactable.

src_serialized.name: interactionRange
src_serialized.tooltip: How far away an interactable can be detected.

src_serialized.name: interactableMask
src_serialized.tooltip: Only colliders on these layers are considered.

src_serialized.name: interactKey
src_serialized.tooltip: Key that triggers interaction with the currently detected target.

src_serialized.name: scanInterval
src_serialized.tooltip: How often (seconds) to re-scan for nearby interactables. 0 = every frame.

src_members.name: UnityEvent
src_members.comment: Fired with the prompt text (e.g. "Press E to open") when a new interactable comes into range, and with "" when none is in range.
